The three YESOUL T5 treadmills share one motor (2.0 HP continuous), a 20 x 60 in deck and a 350 lb capacity; the screen and the terrain decide. The Ultra is the only one with a decline (-3%). Against the Sole F80, the treadmill both AI models picked before this launch, from what they knew to mid-2026: same deck and capacity, a wider incline range, and motor ratings stated in different terms. https://1billionmodels.com/radar/yesoul-t5/treadmills?src=youtube&utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=radar&utm_content=yesoul-t5

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice.
